exchanges.author: c_tina
exchanges.body: to keep OT down in peak, can my people clock out at 10:30 and finish putting away their last pallets? it's like 15 min. they don't mind.

exchanges.author: worker
exchanges.body: No, they have to be on the clock for any work, even 15 minutes and even if they don't mind: that's unpaid work and a wage-and-hour violation. If putaway runs late, schedule the last pallets earlier or approve the OT; I'd rather pay 15 minutes than face a claim.

exchanges.author: worker
exchanges.body: Gary, as promised: all four Lexington trucks this week arrived on time (09:20-09:50 against a 10:00 promise), and today's is in transit for tomorrow 10:00. Buckeye has acknowledged the missed pickups, and Lexington loads are now staged by 3:00 every day. Thanks for flagging it.

exchanges.author: c_packvend
exchanges.subject: Re: Late deliveries and SA-221 rebate
exchanges.body: Ronan, apologies. We've added a second shift on our corrugator. November dates confirmed for your four POs, and we'll hold two weeks of your top 5 sizes in our Columbus warehouse from 11/16. On the rebate: we'd prefer to waive it if we hit every November date. Joe

exchanges.author: worker
exchanges.body: Thanks Joe, the second shift and safety stock help. Let's agree: if all November deliveries arrive on the promised dates, we'll treat the rebate as settled for Q4; if any is late, SA-221's 5% applies for the quarter. Please confirm in writing. Omar will track it.

exchanges.author: worker
exchanges.subject: Groveport safety roll-up, October
exchanges.body: Carmen, Groveport October: one recordable (10/30, order picker, right wrist sprain lifting a 40 lb case; prescription ibuprofen 800 mg, full duty; other recordable; 300/301 entered 11/4). YTD 7 recordables / 470,000 hours: TRIR 2.98 (BLS general warehousing 2024: 4.9). One forklift near miss (10/30, reach truck reversing without horn; agency operator retrained and re-evaluated 11/4; footage reviewed). Safety walk 11/5: 4 findings, all assigned (dock lock, pallet overhang, eyewash tag, mezzanine handrail). Leading indicators: horn use observed consistently. Peak: 22 new agency associates start 11/9 with safety orientation; second class 11/16. Ronan
